title: DooshBank
tagline: Invest in your favorite web3 index funds using AAVE GHO. Create your own index fund plan or invest in an existing one. Eat, Sleep, Invest, Repeat
description: Using smart contracts to create plans (index funds) or investing in existing ones. The user can deposit GHO tokens and it is converted to other tokens in the basket through the Uniswap SwapRouter contract. The user is also provided with a Smart Wallet (Account Abstraction) secured using Passkeys.
how_its_made:
This project uses Biconomy for Smart Contract Accounts and Passkeys for the authentication of wallets and authorization of transactions.
The smart contract will manage the plan creation and also the discovery of existing plans for the user to invest in. Once the user deposits GHO, it is converted to other tokens using Uniswap's SwapRouter contract. The user will also be able to convert all the tokens back to GHO and withdraw.
